verdict.rationale: Calendly's evidence covers Workflows, webhooks, MCP tools, and scheduling automation, but there is no mention of any version history, review process, or rollback mechanism for automations (Workflows, routing forms, or API-configured setups). No audit trail, change diffing, or restore-to-previous-version feature is documented anywhere in the pack. Missing for 10: version history UI, change review/diff tooling, rollback/restore capability for Workflows or routing forms, any audit log of automation edits.
